customize.name: Nod-Krai
customize.desc:
The moon-blessed land located in the northwestern regions of Teyvat.

Follow the silver thread spun by the new moon, traverse biting gales and desolate tundras as the snow-kissed lakes, fractured like mirrors, reflect their ageless, glacial radiance. The days are bitterly short, and the night stretches on like a dark, yawning maw. But even then, the light and song of the Welkin Moon will dance gently across the faces of visiting travelers. Up at ye towers, and let your lanterns blaze into the darkness! Until the day comes... when true moonlight bathes this land once more.

customize.text: In Nod-Krai, Roland and his squad killed not only monsters, but also bandits and cornered vagabonds, who could only join the bandits. People began to shun them as if they carried a curse, and only the

customize.name: Lightkeepers
customize.desc: An ancient organization that has long defended Nod-Krai's freedom and peace against the ceaseless incursions and Wild Hunt attacks launched by the Abyss.

customize.text: were willing to offer them shelter in the lighthouse.

customize.name: Vedrfolnir
customize.desc: One of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, also known as "The Visionary."

customize.text: When Roland realized there was no longer a place for him in this world, he sought death in the lost ancient kingdom of Khaenri'ah. There, he saw Vedrfolnir's revelation and learned of the origins of the monsters he had fought and the fate of the kingdom. Realizing that the gods had unjustly cursed Khaenri'ah, he swore allegiance to the Abyss.

customize.name: Andrius
customize.desc: The Great Wolf King of the North, a protector of Wolvendom and one of the Four Winds.

customize.text: Before the Cataclysm, Roland was believed to become the mightiest Knight of Boreas. 500 years later, the Abyss recreated Roland's image from his memories and merged with a part of Andrius's soul, becoming the leader of the Wild Hunt.

customize.name: Varka
customize.desc: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

customize.text:
The current Knight of Boreas, who stopped "Roland" from the Abyss.
Viridescent
The Viridescent Huntress, who fought the Abyssal monsters 500 years ago, but herself became a monster. She was killed by the Bloodstained Knight.

customize.name: The Black Sword
customize.desc: A pitch-black longsword that thirsts for violence and conflict. It is said that this weapon can cause its user to become drunk on the red wine of slaughter.

customize.name: Elegy for the End
customize.desc: A bow as lovely as any bard's lyre, its arrows pierce the heart like a lamenting sigh.

customize.name: The Viridescent Hunt
customize.desc: A pure green hunting bow. This once belonged to a certain hunter whose home was the forest.
